About.title: About Party Game
About.description: Party Game is a free mobile mini-game web app for groups. No app install needed — just open it in your browser and pass the phone around. Perfect for parties, bars, and hangouts.
About.sharkDesc: 20 teeth, some rotten — press them one by one and hope for the best. Hit a rotten tooth and you get the penalty!
About.sharkHow: Set penalty count (1–5) → Press teeth one by one → Hit a rotten one and pay!
About.cardDesc: Cards are shuffled face-down and each player picks one. Whoever draws the skull diamond gets the penalty!
About.cardHow: Enter player count → Memorize skull position → Cards shuffle → Pick a card → Skull = penalty!
About.tensionDesc: Hold the button to fill the cup. Let go just before it overflows — but nobody knows exactly when that is!
About.tensionHow: Hold the button → Watch the cup fill → Release before overflow → Spill it and pay!
About.tip: No app install required — runs instantly in any mobile browser. One player opens the game, then pass the phone around. All games are completely free.
About.contact: For inquiries, please reach us by email.
